en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a hilly, forested valley with scattered villas and houses. In the upper left a large house labeled "Villa Martha" stands on a slope surrounded by trees. In the upper right the word "Oberkipsdorf" marks the settlement on the hillside. At the bottom edge, conifer trees line the foreground and some terraced or landscaped grounds are visible. The overall style is that of an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.
